requirements.increment_note: 活动时间以 15 分钟（0.25 小时）为最小计量单位累加
requirements.technical_areas_note: 活动须关联到 WCET 七大技术知识领域中的至少一项；整个续证周期内须覆盖其中至少 3 个领域
requirements.min_distinct_years_note: 活动须分布在周期内至少 3 个自然年

activity_categories.label: Professional Activities（专业工作）
activity_categories.rule: Use this page to enter information about significant work you've done in wireless communications and/or wireless patents applied for or awarded.

activity_categories.label: Professional/Industry Volunteer Services（行业志愿服务）
activity_categories.rule: Use this page to report your volunteer service on behalf of the industry. Report only service that is relevant to wireless communications.

activity_categories.label: WCET Program Support（WCET 项目贡献）
activity_categories.rule: Use this page to report any contributions you have made to the WCET certification program.

activity_categories.label: Course Development / Instruction（课程开发 / 授课）
activity_categories.rule: Use this page to report any relevant courses in wireless communications (including short courses at conferences) and/or workshops you have developed, taught or organized.

pdu_per_unit.3year: 开发 2 PDU/小时；授课 1 PDU/小时
pdu_per_unit.5year: 开发 2 PDU/小时；授课 1 PDU/小时

activity_categories.label: Publications（论文 / 著作）
activity_categories.rule: Use this page to report papers published in relevant journals, conference proceedings, etc. and any contributions to published books on wireless communications.

activity_categories.label: ComSoc / Outside Training（正规培训）
activity_categories.rule: Use this page to report any relevant formal training you have taken. Report conference short courses/workshops on the Conferences page.

activity_categories.label: Self-Directed Learning（自学）
activity_categories.rule: Use this page to report any relevant independent study (for example, self-directed computer-based training) you have taken.

activity_categories.label: Other Certifications（其他执照 / 认证）
activity_categories.rule: Use this page to report any additional relevant licenses, certifications, etc. that you have earned.

activity_categories.label: Industry Conferences and Events（行业会议）
activity_categories.rule: Use this page to report your attendance at and participation in  technical conferences, symposia, etc. on wireless communications.

activity_categories.label: Professional / Industrial Community（会员升级）
activity_categories.rule: Use this page to report any upgrades earned in relevant professional/industrial society memberships.

pdu_per_unit.3year: Sr→Fellow 15 / Member→Sr 15 / Student→full 5 / 两级连升 15
pdu_per_unit.5year: Sr→Fellow 20 / Member→Sr 15 / Student→full 5 / 两级连升 15

validation_rules: 总 PDU ≥ 周期下限（三年 60 / 五年 100）
活动分布 ≥3 个自然年
覆盖 ≥3 个 WCET 技术知识领域（共 7 个）
每活动分类 PDU 不超过其周期封顶（cycle_cap）
志愿服务另受每年封顶约束（per_year_cap）
专业工作每年封顶见 pdu_per_unit；每周期仅 1 项专利
执照/认证与培训重复计时不可双报
自学须含评估方法；非纯无线主题按相关占比折算
申报须诚实完整，接受审计；虚假信息可致认证撤销
summary_lines: WCET 续证 PDU 方案：IEEE 无线通信工程技术认证（已于 2019 年停办）的继续教育计分规则。
两个周期模板：三年周期 ≥60 PDU、五年周期 ≥100 PDU；均要求活动覆盖 ≥3 年、≥3 个技术知识领域。
10 个活动分类（专业工作/志愿/WCET贡献/授课/论文/培训/自学/其他认证/会议/会员升级），各有 PDU 计分与周期封顶。
本库为规则知识层（只读），可由 sysweeper 查询与对账；原件为个人模板，不入库。
